help.title: Help & support
help.q1: How do I record a sale?
help.a1: Tap the + button, choose Money in, and either fill the form or just type or say what happened — like "Sold 3 bags of rice at 350 each". You confirm before anything is saved.
help.a2: Left over is your cash: money in minus money out for the period. Profit (estimated) also counts credit sales — money customers still owe you.
help.a3: Yes. Open the record in Money and tap Fix. MI YONE corrects it while keeping the history visible — records are never silently changed.
help.a4: Money → Owed to you lists every customer debt. You can also ask the Partner: "Who owe me?"
help.q5: Does MI YONE work in Krio?
help.a5: Yes — type or speak naturally in English, Krio, or a mix, both when recording and when asking the Partner.

about.body: MI YONE ("My Own") is a financial intelligence and business operating platform for small and growing businesses in Sierra Leone. It records what happens in your business, keeps the numbers honest, and helps you see what they mean.
